text: Implemented pure volume-to-surface sampling over SurfaceGeometryPair and NeuroVol: inspectable plans, named midpoint/fractional-thickness/normal-line paths, nearest/average/mode aggregation, surfaceToWorld plus NeuroSpace lookup, masks, empty sample counts, and synthetic fixtures. Verified with sbt surfaceJVM/test surfaceJS/test: 54 JVM tests and 43 JS tests passed.
